crossRefs.note: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak…
I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua, the son…
He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean…
As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I…
Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to…
but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you…
He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice…
Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

translations.web: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
